verdict.rationale: 1Password ships an official, documented `op` CLI with a get-started guide and a command reference (e.g. `op item list --vault Private`). A runtime probe confirms it is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask (v2.39.0) and serves as the scriptable surface behind service accounts and secrets automation. Its docs also have machine-readable .md mirrors that agents can consume. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of using the CLI in AI/agent workflows, and explicit documentation of agent-oriented CLI features such as structured output for agents.
